reviewer: Claude Code (Opus, orchestrating session) — self-review of the Sonnet implementation agents' work

importantFindings.title: An age conflict could not be resolved in favour of the sheet
importantFindings.evidence: First implementation: ageConflictsWithStoredDate still required a typed age to match the read date, and the conflict box offered only 'Usa l’età dalla data' after the date field was removed.
importantFindings.disposition: Fixed before 6782e2d: renamed ageConflictsWithReadDate; a typed or acknowledged age resolves the conflict; new 'Tieni l’età sul foglio (N)' button; component tests for the three ways out.

importantFindings.title: The phone-copy tip was written into the assistant's prompt
importantFindings.evidence: rosterPastePrompt ended with advice for the operator, sent to the assistant.
importantFindings.disposition: Fixed before 6782e2d: removed from the prompt, shown beside the paste box.

importantFindings.title: Joined-lines recovery trusted a possibly truncated last row
importantFindings.evidence: Without FINE the rebuilt last row was read, unlike the normal path.
importantFindings.disposition: Fixed before 6782e2d: reported as 'forse troncata: manca la riga FINE'; text before and after the block reported like the normal path; unit tests.

importantFindings.title: The measured age accuracy needed the sheets' real course date
importantFindings.evidence: The private harness first compared ages at its fixed reference date (2026-09-22) and reported 15 of 100 ages off by one year.
importantFindings.disposition: Not a defect: every printed age on all five sheets fits one course date between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-16; at 2026-08-03 the review's ages are 100 of 100 correct (0 wrong, 0 unflagged). Aggregates below.

qolFindings.title: Four e2e specs had been written with CRLF line endings
The Allievi list computes every student's age during render; a corrupt stored date would break the list
qolFindings.disposition: Pre-existing, needs corrupt data; recorded in docs/post-mvp/1_0_0_NEXT_STEPS.md.

independentReviewDispositions.F2R-1: Fixed in 9cf5470 (recovery only when row data follows the header on its line; otherwise the preface is reported and the normal path reads the rows); unit tests.
independentReviewDispositions.F2R-2: Fixed in 9cf5470 (a valid age is validated first and the date is then ignored); unit tests; the V05 journey's fixable line changed to a bad date with no age.
independentReviewDispositions.F2R-3: Fixed in 9cf5470 (isValidDateOnly guard; the form starts from the declared age or empty and a save drops the bad date); component test.
independentReviewDispositions.F2R-4: Accepted as a known limitation: a surname equal to a placeholder word (e.g. 'Nota') is shown as unread and is fixed in place; recorded in docs/post-mvp/1_0_0_NEXT_STEPS.md.
